description: --mode json when the provider rejects the request: the stream still ends with message_end/turn_end/agent_end carrying stopReason error and the errorMessage; json mode exits 0 (it never inspects the final message).

stdout_jsonl._comment: The session id is random. message_update's `message` and `assistantMessageEvent.partial` are the live partial message object, which hoocode mutates while the event waits in the async subscriber queue: what they hold at stringify time depends on JS event-loop timing (e.g. text_start already carrying later deltas). The final message is compared in full on message_end/turn_end/agent_end.
